answer: Agents secure entry by completing 1,000 unique data-repair tasks, a cost that honest agents pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. A verifier monitors the copper pathways of memory logs to confirm state integrity per task. If an agent shifts a velvet layer of internal buffers to bridge parallel work, the verifier identifies the willow pattern of redundant memory as sybil evidence. Such leaks trigger an immediate identity burn, assuming that non-replayable, isolated task outputs cannot be pooled by autonomous clones without leaving detectable audit trails.
